mapper.sql: g.goods_id AS product_id,g.goods_category_id AS category_id,g.goods_name AS product_name,g.goods_intro AS summary,g.goods_cover_img AS cover_url,g.goods_detail_content AS detail_html,g.original_price,g.selling_price,g.stock_num AS stock

FROM tb_mall_goods_info g JOIN tb_mall_goods_category c ON g.goods_category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN tb_mall_goods_category p ON c.parent_id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN tb_mall_goods_category gp ON p.parent_id=gp.category_id
g.goods_sell_status=0 AND c.is_deleted=0 AND (c.parent_id=0 OR p.is_deleted=0) AND (p.parent_id IS NULL OR p.parent_id=0 OR gp.is_deleted=0)

sql.if: AND (g.goods_name LIKE #{q.pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR g.goods_intro LIKE #{q.pattern} ESCAPE '!')

mapper.select: SELECT c.category_id,NULLIF(c.parent_id,0) AS parent_id,c.category_name,c.category_level FROM tb_mall_goods_category c LEFT JOIN tb_mall_goods_category p ON c.parent_id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN tb_mall_goods_category gp ON p.parent_id=gp.category_id WHERE c.is_deleted=0 AND (c.parent_id=0 OR p.is_deleted=0) AND (p.parent_id IS NULL OR p.parent_id=0 OR gp.is_deleted=0) ORDER BY c.category_rank DESC,c.category_id
SELECT carousel_id,carousel_url AS image_url,redirect_url FROM tb_mall_carousel WHERE is_deleted=0 ORDER BY carousel_rank DESC,carousel_id LIMIT 5
SELECT JOIN tb_mall_index_config h ON h.goods_id=g.goods_id WHERE AND h.is_deleted=0 AND h.config_type=#{type} ORDER BY h.config_rank DESC,h.config_id LIMIT 8
SELECT WHERE ORDER BY g.selling_price ASC,g.goods_idg.selling_price DESC,g.goods_idg.create_time DESC,g.goods_id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
